strategies.overview: Giratina-O is most notable for being the only offensive Defog user in Ubers, giving it a distinct niche. Its high bulk and unique typing combined with Levitate give it great use against top metagame threats like Arceus-Ground, Extreme Killer Arceus, and Kyogre. While its offensive stats are a bit low by Ubers standards, it makes up for it with Griseous Core's boost and access to high-Base Power moves like Poltergeist, Draco Meteor, and Hex. Furthermore, Will-O-Wisp, Thunder Wave, and Shadow Sneak are all great utility options at Giratina-O's disposal. Giratina-O is also one of the best users of Terastallization in the tier, becoming extremely tanky with Tera Steel or Poison in combination with Levitate. However, Giratina-O has no reliable recovery and thus can be chipped down by Stealth Rock and Ruination damage over time. It also stacks weaknesses with Koraidon and Miraidon, two of the most common Pokemon in the tier.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Shadow Ball is possible over Hex to have a stronger attack in the short term; this may notably help against Dragon Dance Arceus-Ground. Calm Mind sets are a possibility, but Giratina-O's lack of recovery really limits its ability to sweep.

Checks and Counters

Support Arceus Formes: Arceus formes like Arceus-Fairy and Arceus-Water can shrug off any attack Giratina-O throws at them, though neither appreciate status.

Ho-Oh: Ho-Oh can handle most attacks from Giratina-O, as it has high bulk and is immune to Will-O-Wisp. However, Stone Edge, Thunder Wave, and Tera Ghost-boosted Poltergeist all threaten Ho-Oh.

Chip Damage: Giratina-O has no recovery, so damage from poison, burn, or Stealth Rock can add up over time. Ting-Lu's Ruination can also greatly reduce Giratina-O's ability to check threats.

movesets.name: Physical Utility
movesets.description:
Although it necessitates teammates like Necrozma-DM to not run Knock Off, Poltergeist is a strong Ghost-type attack that is very spammable due to how few Pokemon that resist Ghost there are in the tier. Dragon Tail is a decently strong Dragon-type attack that has utility for forcing out Extreme Killer Arceus, which often runs Taunt, and Ting-Lu. Of the two status options, Will-O-Wisp should be run with Defog, as it pressures Ting-Lu much more; Ting-Lu can otherwise heal off damage with Leftovers, pressure Giratina-O with Ruination, and set entry hazards. Thunder Wave pressures common switch-ins like Ho-Oh and Arceus-Fairy much more, and as such is preferred when not running Defog. Access to Defog is extremely few and far between in Ubers, and therefore Giratina-O's access to it provides immense utility. It can be critical for maintaining an advantage in entry hazard management, especially once opposing entry hazard setters like Ting-Lu are taken out of the picture. Despite this utility, other options are still available for more offensively-minded teams. Shadow Sneak is a useful priority move that becomes very strong when combined with Tera Ghost; the combination of Tera Ghost Poltergeist and Shadow Sneak will even take out Koraidon. Alternatively, Stone Edge can be used to KO Ho-Oh, which otherwise takes non-Tera Ghost Poltergeist without worry. The given EVs allow Giratina-O to survive +2 Tera Ghost Arceus's Shadow Claw as well as +2 Life Orb Arceus's Shadow Claw after Stealth Rock damage. The Speed EVs are enough to outspeed uninvested Gliscor, with the rest dumped into Attack. Tera Steel should be run on Defog sets, as it negates all of Giratina-O's normal weaknesses, allowing Giratina-O to turn the tide against many Pokemon such as Koraidon using Scale Shot and Gliscor using Toxic. Tera Poison is another option, as it provides similar utility to Tera Steel without being weak to Koraidon's Flare Blitz.

Giratina-O is an excellent way to finish off most defensive cores in the tier, as its Defog support and ability to check Arceus-Ground, Extreme Killer Arceus, and Kyogre are very valuable. As such, classic defensive Pokemon like Necrozma-DM, Arceus-Fairy, Ting-Lu, and Arceus-Water are all fantastic partners. Miraidon deserves mention, since it can pressure Ting-Lu, Clodsire, and Gliscor extremely well, potentially leading to a huge advantage in entry hazard management. Giratina-O's Defog support can also enable some powerful wallbreakers like Choice Band Chien-Pao and Choice Specs Kyogre, which may not normally fit on most teams due to being too weak to entry hazards.

movesets.name: Special Utility
movesets.description:
Thunder Wave is Giratina-O's best option for punishing Ho-Oh and Arceus-Fairy, while Will-O-Wisp is a stronger option against Arceus, Dragon Dance Arceus-Ground, and Ting-Lu. Giratina-O's access to Defog gives it a unique niche on bulky offense and balance teams that can sufficiently pressure Ting-Lu. The given EV spread lets Giratina-O survive Shadow Claw from both Life Orb Arceus and Heavy-Duty Boots Tera Ghost Arceus after a Swords Dance and Stealth Rock damage while outspeeding uninvested Gliscor. Tera Steel lets Giratina-O stonewall Gliscor and Dragon Dance Necrozma-DM, pivot into Arceus-Fairy more easily, and take on Scale Shot Koraidon and Miraidon. Tera Poison is an alternative that still punishes Gliscor and Arceus-Fairy without giving Giratina-O a weakness to Low Kick and Flare Blitz from Koraidon and Close Combat from Zacian-C.

Giratina-O pairs well with teams that appreciate its ability to both check Arceus-Ground, Necrozma-DM, and Extreme Killer Arceus and keep entry hazards off the field against Spikes stacking teams. Arceus-Fairy and Gliscor are strong partners for their ability to punish Ting-Lu while pivoting around Koraidon and Miraidon, respectively. Necrozma-DM is a great partner to pressure Ho-Oh with Knock Off, Stone Edge, or boosted Photon Geyser. This is appreciated, since Ho-Oh can pivot into Giratina-O and entirely wall Will-O-Wisp variants while also checking Arceus-Fairy. Teammates that use Choice items such as Choice Scarf Koraidon, Choice Specs Miraidon, Choice Specs Kyogre, Choice Specs Flutter Mane, and Choice Band Chien-Pao appreciate Giratina-O removing hazards from the field, letting them not take hazard damage when they switch in and thus giving them more opportunities against bulkier teams that can annoy Giratina-O. Other teammates that appreciate Defog include Calm Mind Kyogre with Leftovers, Draco Plate Miraidon, and defensive Arceus formes. Miraidon is an especially notable partner for forcing progress on Ting-Lu while pivoting around Ho-Oh, letting Giratina-O win the hazard war in the long run. Ting-Lu and Gliscor pair well with Giratina-O by checking Miraidon and complementing Giratina-O's ability to spread status with additional hazard damage.

movesets.name: Defensive
movesets.description: Thanks to its bulk, typing, and Levitate ability, defensive Giratina-O checks Pokemon like Arceus, Arceus-Ground, and Choice Scarf Kyogre, and it is the only metagame-relevant Defog user. Will-O-Wisp and Thunder Wave both debilitate physical attackers, but Will-O-Wisp chips away at walls and affects Dragon Dance Arceus-Ground, while Thunder Wave additionally impairs special attackers such as Calm Mind Arceus-Fairy. Poltergeist breaks Arceus-Ground's Substitute, which would otherwise block Will-O-Wisp and Dragon Tail, in one hit; alternatively, running Hex lets Giratina-O hit statused walls harder and makes burn affect it much less. Dragon Tail quickly racks up entry hazard damage on the opposing team and prevents foes from continuously setting up against Giratina-O, which is especially useful against Taunt users. The given EV spread lets Giratina take unboosted Calyrex-S's Astral Barrage and outspeed Taunt Landorus-T. Tera Steel makes Giratina-O immune to poison from foes such as Toxapex and gives it a resistance to moves like Arceus-Fairy's Judgment, Zacian-C's Play Rough and Behemoth Blade, Koraidon's Scale Shot, and Arceus-Ground's Dragon Claw and Ice Beam. Tera Poison similarly removes Giratina-O's Dragon weakness and provides it with an immunity to Toxic and a resistance to Fairy, but it doesn't make Giratina-O weak to Koraidon's Low Kick. Defensive Giratina-O fits best on balance teams that otherwise have trouble dealing with Ground-types such as Dragon Dance Arceus-Ground or need the increased longevity Defog provides. Toxapex and Skeledirge handle Pokemon like Zacian-C and Koraidon for Giratina-O; in return, it handles Ground-types and helps check Arceus. Giratina-O appreciates Ting-Lu and Arceus checking Calyrex-S for it; Ting-Lu also checks Miraidon and helps check Calm Mind Arceus-Ground. Calyrex-S likes Giratina-O being able to deal with its two main switch-ins, Arceus and Ting-Lu, by checking the former and removing the latter's Spikes. Because it lacks recovery, Giratina-O can get overwhelmed by the Pokemon it checks when facing hyper offense teams, so it appreciates revenge killers such as Extreme Killer Arceus and Choice Scarf Koraidon.

movesets.name: Offensive
movesets.description: Giratina-O has a unique role due to great natural bulk, valuable immunities to Normal-, Ground-, and Fighting-type attacks, and a stellar offensive presence. Dragon Tail is the preferred Dragon-type STAB move due to the utility it gives for checking threats like Dragon Dance Arceus-Ground and Extreme Killer Arceus, as well as racking up extra damage with the Spikes that Giratina-O loves. Will-O-Wisp cripples Ting-Lu—preventing it from accruing HP with Leftovers—and scares away offensive Pokemon like Arceus, Koraidon, and Zacian-C. Alternatively, Outrage provides greater brute force to muscle through Ting-Lu and Arceus, and Thunder Wave can cripple would-be checks like Arceus-Fairy. Tera Steel resists many common attacks aimed at Giratina-O: Ice Beam from Kyogre and Arceus-Ground, Dragon-type moves from Koraidon and Miraidon, Play Rough from Zacian-C, and Judgment from Arceus-Fairy. The given EV spread always lives Calyrex-S's Astral Barrage and +2 Life Orb Arceus's Shadow Claw; 12 Speed EVs outspeeds uninvested Landorus-T to use Will-O-Wisp before Taunt. Giratina-O fits best on bulky offense teams that appreciate it deterring Choice Scarf Koraidon's Low Kick and Flare Blitz and checking Arceus, Arceus-Ground, and Kyogre while still being a powerful attacker. Ting-Lu is a major nuisance for Giratina-O, as it is able to come in quite safely and set Spikes, though it must fear Dragon Tail with multiple layers of Spikes, so teammates that can threaten it like Arceus-Fairy, Zacian-C, and Koraidon are good partners. Entry hazard support from Landorus-T and your own Ting-Lu is greatly appreciated, chipping checks like Ting-Lu and defensive Arceus formesand weakening offensive threats like Koraidon and Arceus-Ground into Shadow Sneak's KO range. Ting-Lu and Landorus-T also support Giratina-O defensively; the former checks Miraidon, Eternatus, and Terastallized Calyrex-S; the latter checks Zacian-C and helps against Arceus and Arceus-Ground. Arceus is a good offensive partner that can overwhelm shared checks with Giratina-O like defensive Arceus formes while taking advantage of Calyrex-S that are forced to Terastallize from the threat of a Shadow Sneak OHKO. Koraidon is another good partner that helps pressure Ting-Lu, check Kyogre, and overwhelm their shared checks. Zacian-C checks Arceus-Fairy and helps handle Arceus while not letting up on offensive pressure.

movesets.name: Physical Utility
movesets.description:
• Giratina-O's great offensive typing, coupled with Levitate, allows it to reliably Defog against staple entry hazard setters such as Primal Groudon and Necrozma-DM; it is also able to check strong attackers including Extreme Killer Arceus, Dragon Dance Arceus-Ground, and Ho-Oh. However, although its typing is excellent offensively, it leaves a bit to be desired defensively, since Giratina-O is weak to a lot of common types in the tier, which doesn't go well with Giratina-O's lack of reliable recovery. Regardless, these useful traits make Giratina-O a staple on bulky offense and balance teams alike.
  • Dragon Tail prevents setup from opposing threats such as Arceus and Primal Groudon, which Giratina-O would otherwise struggle to slow down due to their natural bulk.
  • Toxic punishes switch-ins such as Arceus-Fairy and Yveltal, as well as threatening defensive Primal Groudon that would handle Poltergeist more directly, making it the most consistent of the bunch because it will always be useful in a game. Will-O-Wisp cripples physical attackers such as Zacian-C and Necrozma-DM, preventing Giratina-O from being too passive against the former, while Thunder Wave handles threats such as Eternatus and Calm Mind Arceus formes lacking Refresh.
  • Shadow Sneak is a niche alternative that allows Giratina-O to revenge kill frailer foes such as Deoxys-A and Mega Mewtwo Y, but this comes at the cost of not being able to punish bulkier switch-ins like defensive Yveltal or Arceus-Fairy.
  • The following EV spread allows Giratina-O to avoid the 2HKO from Mega Salamence's Double Edge while 2HKOing defensive Necrozma-DM and offensive Eternatus with Poltergeist. An alternative EV spread can be used for Shadow Sneak variants, allowing Giratina-O to avoid the 2HKO from Mega Mewtwo Y's Psystrike while ensuring a 3HKO on defensive Primal Groudon and an OHKO against offensive Necrozma-DM, both after Stealth Rock.
  • Giratina-O's typing is really important to the balance and bulky offense playstyles it fits on, so Terastallizing Giratina-O is only useful in emergencies. Tera Poison allows Giratina-O to gain a poison immunity while also providing a resistance to Fairy, which is useful versus Arceus-Fairy and Play Rough Zacian-C. Unlike Tera Steel, it avoids being weak to Fire and Fighting, preventing Giratina-O from being weak to Low Kick Marshadow and Overheat Primal Groudon.
  • Tera Steel, however, grants a Rock resistance, which is useful versus Stone Edge Primal Groudon and Dragon Dance Arceus-Ground, while also letting Giratina-O handle Mega Salamence, Rayquaza, and Ultra Necrozma more comfortably. It also lets Giratina-O tank Dragon-type attacks from offensive Eternatus and phaze it away with Dragon Tail, removing its boosts and hitting it hard. However, it makes Giratina-O a riskier switch-in to Overheat and Heat Crash variants of Primal Groudon, as well as making it weak to Fighting-type moves from Marshadow and Zacian-C.
  • Because Giratina-O cannot reliably heal, health management is very important, which includes avoiding status, such as poison from Ho-Oh. This is to ensure Giratina-O has enough HP to reliably check what it needs to, since it would otherwise be overwhelmed by boosted attacks from Primal Groudon and Extreme Killer Arceus.
  • Against bulkier teams, it would be more beneficial for Giratina-O to use status moves such as Toxic or Thunder Wave to benefit its teammates more rather than attempting to deal damage with Poltergeist. This is because the status moves have better long-term impact against switch-ins like Arceus-Dark and Arceus-Fairy, while they would otherwise be able to just heal up any damage taken from Poltergeist. This is also why Toxic is generally the best option out of the three status moves, since it allows Giratina-O to make more progress versus Zygarde and Primal Groudon; the latter is a Pokemon Giratina-O should ordinarily check but can't due to its lackluster damage output against it.
  • Due to Giratina-O's lack of healing, Alomomola is an excellent teammate for it, as it is able to pivot into Giratina-O against Pokemon that would otherwise take advantage of it, such as Necrozma-DM and Primal Groudon, while also healing it up via Wish; Alomomola is also a great status absorber for Giratina-O, letting the latter avoid the residual damage it hates taking, such as Ho-Oh's Sacred Fire burns, while letting Giratina-O run status moves aside from Toxic such as Thunder Wave to better handle Zacian-C and Eternatus. Alomomola is also good at enabling Pokemon that Giratina-O appreciates, such as Chien-Pao, which threatens out Zygarde and Yveltal, and Ditto, which helps pressure out offensive sweepers such as Zacian-C and Meteor Beam Eternatus.
  • Arceus-Fairy makes up for Giratina-O's weaknesses to Dark-types including Yveltal and Arceus-Dark while handling Marshadow and switching into opposing Dragon-type attacks from Palkia-O to preserve Giratina-O's health. Stealth Rock variants are especially appreciated, since Giratina-O can abuse hazards well with Dragon Tail. This also applies to other hazard setters including Primal Groudon and Necrozma-DM, both of which handle the Fairy-types that Giratina-O cannot deal with; the former also helps versus Primal Kyogre, which would chip Giratina-O down with Ice Beam.
  • Offensive teammates such as Zacian-C and Necrozma-DM appreciate Giratina-O breaking down defensive walls such as Primal Groudon and defensive Necrozma-DM, while they in return handle the Dragon-, Fairy- and Ice-types that Giratina-O cannot handle, including Eternatus, Arceus-Fairy and Calyrex-I; the former also handles Dark-types such as Yveltal and Arceus-Dark.

movesets.name: Special Utility
movesets.description:
• Thanks to its excellent typing paired with Levitate, Giratina-O serves as an excellent Defogger on bulky offense structures and checks common threats such as Primal Groudon, Coil Zygarde, and Arceus. With a Specially Offensive set, Giratina-O is able to more immediately threaten Primal Groudon and Zygarde while dealing much more damage to Yveltal and Eternatus. Giratina-O can also fit on balance structures with Alomomola's Wish support due to the amazing role compression it offers. Giratina-O needs Alomomola support in order to offset its longevity issues and survive for the longer games balance teams tend to have.
  • Giratina-O's choice of status determines what it is able to cripple long-term and what it cannot deal with. The status selection highly depends on the team composition Giratina-O finds itself on. Will-O-Wisp and Thunder Wave are strong into offense, while Toxic can help break down Primal Groudon and Ho-Oh balances. Will-O-Wisp is able to cripple threats such as Zacian-C, Arceus, and Dragon Dance Arceus-Ground. Thunder Wave is able to deal with Pokemon such as Zacian-C and Eternatus by allowing teammates such as Marshadow and Eternatus to outspeed these threats. Toxic chips down Ho-Oh, Zygarde, Primal Groudon, and support Arceus formes, allowing allies such as Zacian-C and Marshadow more easily sweep late-game. However, Toxic sets greatly struggle with Zacian-C, Dragon Dance Necrozma-DM, and Calm Mind Arceus formes running Tera Poison.
  • The given EV spread avoids a 2HKO from Primal Groudon's Eruption and Mega Mewtwo Y's Psystrike after Stealth Rock. In addition, it guarantees a 2HKO on Eruption Primal Groudon with Draco Meteor. Giratina-O can invest 12 Speed EVs to outspeed paralyzed Zacian-C, though this means defensive EVs must be sacrificed. The second EV spread allows Giratina-O to survive a +3 Behemoth Blade from Zacian-C, a +2 Stone Edge from Primal Groudon, a Life Orb Yveltal's Dark Pulse, and a Tera Ghost Deoxys-A's Shadow Ball from full HP. It also is highly likely that Arceus-Dark's Foul Play is a 3HKO. In addition, Hex 3HKOes Coil Zygarde after status and Draco Meteor 2HKOed utility Swords Dance Primal Groudon, and Giratina-O can outspeed uninvested Zygarde and paralyzed Zacian-C.
  • A well-timed Terastallization is extremely powerful with Giratina-O. Tera Poison allows Giratina-O to tank any +3 attack from Zacian-C or Dynamax Cannon from Eternatus. This allows Giratina-O to deliver a devastating Will-O-Wisp or Thunder Wave to cripple these threats for the rest of the game. In addition, it is useful to check Marshadow, offensive Eternatus, and non-Taunt Arceus-Fairy. The poison immunity also gives Giratina-O much more longevity against bulky balance and stall structures.
  • Tera Steel provides similar utility as Tera Poison such as tanking a hit from Zacian-C lacking Close Combat or defensive Eternatus while delivering a crippling status and gaining a poison immunity. Tera Steel is able to wall Arceus-Ground, Ultra Necrozma, defensive Eternatus, and Mega Salamence more efficiently. However, Giratina-O loses the ability to check Primal Groudon sets with Overheat or Eruption and is still vulnerable to offensive Eternatus with Fire Blast. In addition, Giratina-O becomes vulnerable to Close Combat from Zacian-C and Low Kick from Marshadow.
  • Giratina-O serves as a Defogger and a reliable switch-in to all Primal Groudon sets on bulky offense, though it does not appreciate getting hit by Toxic. It is also valued for its status, allowing it to cripple threats such as Zacian-C and offensive Eternatus. Due to Giratina-O's limited longevity, it should be used sparingly early-game so that it has enough HP to fulfill these roles. As Zacian-C and Meteor Beam Eternatus can quickly run through defensive cores, Giratina-O should preserve its HP to cripple these threats with status in most cases. Teammates that have better longevity such as Arceus-Fairy and Calm Mind Arceus-Dark should be used to scout sets from threats such as Yveltal early-game. In addition, Coil Zygarde and Primal Groudon are appreciated to check physical wallbreakers such as Choice Band Marshadow early-game. Giratina-O also appreciates offensive teammates such as Marshadow and Dragon Dance Zygarde.
  • Giratina-O does not have the longevity to fit well on most balance structures, but Alomomola patches Giratina-O's longevity issues with Wish. This allows Giratina-O to be more aggressive in checking threats such as Primal Groudon and Zygarde early-game. In addition, Alomomola is able to easily use Toxic against Primal Groudon and Ho-Oh, allowing Giratina-O to drop Toxic to better check Zacian-C and Eternatus. However, this core struggles against Calm Mind Arceus formes, so Pokemon such as Taunt Arceus-Fairy, Fezandipiti, and defensive Eternatus are essential.
  • Giratina-O struggles massively against Taunt + Calm Mind Arceus-Dark and Arceus-Fairy. Therefore, Pokemon such as Zacian-C make excellent teammates. Giratina-O also struggles against specially offensive Yveltal, so Calm Mind Arceus-Dark, Fezandipiti, defensive and Calm Mind Arceus-Fairy, and Heavy-Duty Boots defensive Eternatus are great allies. Giratina-O is able to cripple threats such as Zacian-C, Eternatus, and Dragon Dance Arceus-Ground lacking Taunt with status moves. Giratina-O can become setup fodder to defensive Primal Kyogre, so Pokemon such as Ferrothorn and defensive Primal Groudon are useful teammates. In exchange, Giratina-O checks opposing Primal Groudon that threaten them. Giratina-O is also bad into stall and walled by Chansey. Therefore, Defensive Kyogre is a great teammate.
